Melanoma, the most lethal form of skin cancer, poses significant therapeutic challenges despite advances in immunotherapy. Natural compounds have emerged as promising adjuncts for modulating immune checkpoint pathways, including PD-1/PD-L1, CTLA-4, and LAG-3. A systematic review was conducted from inception to July 2025, searching the Web of Science, PubMed/MEDLINE, and Scopus.
